description: Create the new file repos/goal-host-vessel/src/goal-intent.creation-routing.test.ts. Use EXACTLY this import line as the first line: import { isEditIntentGoal } from './goal-intent'; (the sibling module is ./goal-intent — do NOT import from ./goal-intent.creation-routing). Then a bun:test file (import { describe, expect, it } from 'bun:test') with three assertions: expect(isEditIntentGoal('Create repos/foo/bar.ts with a helper')).toBe(true); expect(isEditIntentGoal('Author repos/x/y.ts')).toBe(true); expect(isEditIntentGoal('Summarise repos/x/y.ts')).toBe(false). This locks in the creation-verb routing added to isEditIntentGoal.
